I'd also like to see a significant portion, around 15-20%, dedicated to green spaces, as they play a vital role in fostering a sense of community and promoting environmental sustainability. Additionally, I'd allocate around 15-20% to economic development to support local businesses and job creation, and smaller percentages to infrastructure and community connection initiatives. By taking a holistic approach, I believe we can make a meaningful impact and create a more connected, thriving community for all residents
